svg.title: Usage-Streak: all streak auras
svg.desc: Dormant at zero days. Ember at one, Flame at three, Coral at seven, Violet at fourteen, Aurora at thirty, Solar at ninety. Active vector flames run at 24 frames per second. Slow looping halos follow their colors. These are illustrative milestones, not account data.
svg.text: Current streak sets the aura. Zero stays still. Reduced motion is respected.
